# Patrick W. Davis

> Commercial and marketing leader with 25+ years in luxury hospitality, destination marketing, and multi-property resort sales. Based in Vail, Colorado. Advisory council member of the Vail Local Marketing District (Vail's DMO). Former Director of Sales and Marketing at The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort. Former Area Associate Director of Sales at Grand Hyatt Washington and Hyatt Regency Washington. BS in Hospitality Management, Colorado State University.
